then in the subsequent simulation frames this SimVar may be set to 1 (TRUE) again as the engine restarts automatically.

units: Percent of max rated rpm for the indexed engine (see note). NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all far aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: GENERAL ENG PROPELLER LEVER POSITION
units: Percent of max prop lever position for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: GENERAL ENG REVERSE THRUST ENGAGED
units: This will return 1 (TRUE) if the reverse thruster is engaged
or 0 (FALSE) otherwise.

simvars.name: GENERAL ENG RPM
units: The RPM for an indexed engine (see note). NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all far aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: GENERAL ENG STARTER
units: The indexed engine (see note) starter on/off state.

simvars.name: GENERAL ENG STARTER ACTIVE
units: True if the indexed engine (see note) starter is active. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all near aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: GENERAL ENG THROTTLE LEVER POSITION
units: Percent of max throttle position for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: GENERAL ENG THROTTLE MANAGED MODE
units: Current mode of the managed throttle for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: MASTER IGNITION SWITCH
units: Aircraft master ignition switch (grounds all engines magnetos).

simvars.name: MAX EGT
units: The maximum EGT
as set using the egt_peak_temperature parameter in the engines.cfg file.

simvars.name: MAX OIL TEMPERATURE
units: The maximum oil temperature
as set using the parameter oil_temp_heating_constant in the engines.cfg file.

simvars.name: MAX RATED ENGINE RPM
units: Maximum rated rpm for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: NUMBER OF ENGINES
units: Number of engines (minimum 0
maximum 4)

simvars.name: OIL AMOUNT
units: Deprecated
do not use!

simvars.name: PANEL AUTO FEATHER SWITCH
units: Auto-feather arming switch for the indexed engine (see note). Please see the Note On Autofeathering for more information.

simvars.name: PROP AUTO CRUISE ACTIVE
units: True if prop auto cruise active

simvars.name: PROP AUTO FEATHER ARMED
units: Auto-feather armed state for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: PROP BETA
units: The "prop beta" is the pitch of the blades of the propeller
and this can be used to retrieve the current pitch setting
per indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: PROP BETA FORCED ACTIVE
units: This can be used to enable the propeller forced beta mode (1
TRUE) or disable it (0
FALSE)
when being written to. When being read from
it will return TRUE (1) if the forced beta mode is enabled or FALSE (0) if it isn't. When enabled
the PROP BETA FORCED POSITION value will be used to drive the prop beta
while the internal coded simulation logic is used when this is disabled.

simvars.name: PROP BETA FORCED POSITION
units: Get or set the target beta to which the prop is forced. This value will be approximated during the simulation at a rate of 5°/second. Note that this "forcing" will respect the beta_max limit (but will ignore the beta_min). Only valid when PROP BETA FORCED ACTIVE is TRUE (1).

simvars.name: PROP BETA MAX
units: The "prop beta" is the pitch of the blades of the propeller. This retrieves the maximum possible pitch value for all engines.

simvars.name: PROP BETA MIN
units: The "prop beta" is the pitch of the blades of the propeller. This retrieves the minimum possible pitch value for all engines.

simvars.name: PROP BETA MIN REVERSE
units: The "prop beta" is the pitch of the blades of the propeller. This retrieves the minimum possible pitch value when the propeller is in reverse for all engines.

simvars.name: PROP DEICE SWITCH
units: True if prop deice switch on for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: PROP FEATHERED
units: This will return the feathered state of the propeller for an indexed engine (see note). The state is either feathered (true) or not (false).

simvars.name: PROP FEATHERING INHIBIT
units: Feathering inhibit flag for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: PROP FEATHER SWITCH
units: Prop feather switch for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: PROP MAX RPM PERCENT
units: Percent of max rated rpm for the indexed engine (see note). NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all near aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: PROP ROTATION ANGLE
units: Prop rotation angle. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all near aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: PROP RPM
units: Propeller rpm for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: PROP SYNC ACTIVE
units: True if prop sync is active the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: PROP SYNC DELTA LEVER
units: Corrected prop correction input on slaved engine for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: PROP THRUST
units: Propeller thrust for the indexed engine (see note). NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all near aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: PROPELLER ADVANCED SELECTION
units: Deprecated
do not use!

simvars.name: SHUTOFF VALVE PULLED
units: This checks if the shutoff valve to the engine has been pulled (true) or not (false). When pulled piston engines will be blocked from getting any fuel.

simvars.name: THROTTLE INPUT BLOCKED BY LOWER BOUNDS
units: Settable boolean triggering the notification for the indexed throttle blocked at the lower bounds when user tries to go past it. When requested with no index parameter
the SimVar will return 1 (TRUE) if any engine index throttle is true. When trying to set the SimVar with no index
then all engine throttles will be set to the specified value.

simvars.name: THROTTLE INPUT BLOCKED BY UPPER BOUNDS
units: Settable boolean triggering the notification for the throttle blocked at the upper bounds when user tries to go past it. When requested with no index parameter
the SimVar will return 1 (TRUE) if any engine index throttle is true. When trying to set the SimVar with no index
then all engine throttles will be set to the specified value.

simvars.name: THROTTLE LOWER LIMIT
units: Percent throttle defining lower limit (negative for reverse thrust equipped airplanes).

simvars.name: TURB ENG AFTERBURNER
units: Afterburner state for the indexed engine (see note). NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all near aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: TURB ENG AFTERBURNER PCT ACTIVE
units: The percentage that the afterburner is running at. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all near aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: TURB ENG AFTERBURNER STAGE ACTIVE
units: The stage of the afterburner
or 0 if the afterburner is not active. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all near aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: TURB ENG BLEED AIR
units: Bleed air pressure for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: TURB ENG COMMANDED N1
units: Effective commanded N1 for the indexed turbine engine (see note). The way this value is caluclated will depend on the following: For a jet engine the calculation depends on the use_commanded_Ne_table parameter: If true
the return value is calculated depending on use_n2_to_n1_table
commanded Ne and inlet Mach. If false

the return value is equal to commanded Ne. For a turbo-prop or helo-turbine engine the return value is calculated depending on throttle position and mixture control. Also note that while this SimVar is writeable
the written information will be overridden by the simulation on the very next frame.

simvars.name: TURB ENG CONDITION LEVER POSITION
units: When the throttle is on idle position
this sets the condition levers to one of 3 positions to define the idle N1 target for the indexed engine (see note): Down position is the cut-off position that cuts the fuel to the engine

effectively shutting down the engine. Middle position requires N1 to reach the low idle value when throttle is in idle position (low idle value can be checked using the TURB_ENG_LOW_IDLE SimVar). High position requires N1 to reach the high idle value when throttle is in idle position (high idle value can be checked using the TURB_ENG_HIGH_IDLE SimVar). Note that this option requires several settings from the engines.cfg file to be set to specific values before working correctly: DisableMixtureControls needs to be set to 1 (TRUE). tp_idle_range should be set to 0 (since there is no mixture setting). and idle_high_fuel_flow must be set to the same value (since there is no mixture setting to induce a variation between the 2). and high_idle_n1 to be correctly set.

simvars.name: TURB ENG CORRECTED FF
units: Corrected fuel flow for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: TURB ENG CORRECTED N1
units: The indexed turbine engine (see note) corrected N1.

simvars.name: TURB ENG CORRECTED N2
units: The indexed turbine engine (see note) corrected N2.

simvars.name: TURB ENG FREE TURBINE TORQUE
units: The amount of free torque for the indexed turbine engine (see note).

simvars.name: TURB ENG FUEL AVAILABLE
units: True if fuel is available for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: TURB ENG FUEL EFFICIENCY LOSS
units: This is used to control the fuel efficiency loss of the indexed engine
from 0 - no fuel efficiency loss - to 100 - double the fuel consumption.

simvars.name: TURB ENG FUEL FLOW PPH
units: The indexed engine (see note) fuel flow rate.

simvars.name: TURB ENG HIGH IDLE
units: Retrieves the high idle N1 value to be reached by the the indexed turboprop engine (see note) with throttle in idle position and condition lever in high idle position (condition lever position can be checked or set using the TURB_ENG_CONDITION_LEVER_POSITION SimVar).

simvars.name: TURB ENG IGNITION SWITCH
units: True if the the indexed turbine engine (see note) ignition switch is on.

simvars.name: TURB ENG IGNITION SWITCH EX1
units: Position of the the indexed turbine engine (see note) Ignition Switch. Similar to TURB_ENG_IGNITION_SWITCH but differentiates between ON and AUTO.

simvars.name: TURB ENG IS IGNITING
units: Whether or not the ignition system is currently running for the indexed engine (see note). Depends on TURB_ENG_IGNITION_SWITCH_EX1 Enum
the cfg var ignition_auto_type and current state of the plane.

simvars.name: TURB ENG ITT
units: Retrieve or set the ITT for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: TURB ENG ITT COOLING EFFICIENCY LOSS
units: This is used to control the ITT cooling efficiency loss of the indexed engine
from 0 - no cooling efficiency loss - to 100 -engine recieves no ITT cooling.

simvars.name: TURB ENG JET THRUST
units: The indexed engine (see note) jet thrust.

simvars.name: TURB ENG LOW IDLE
units: Retrieves the low idle N1 value to be reached by the the indexed turboprop engine (see note) with throttle in idle position and condition lever in low idle position (condition lever position can be checked or set using the TURB_ENG_CONDITION_LEVER_POSITION SimVar).

simvars.name: TURB ENG MASTER STARTER SWITCH
units: True if the turbine engine master starter switch is on
false otherwise.

simvars.name: TURB ENG MAX TORQUE PERCENT
units: Percent of max rated torque for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: TURB ENG N1
units: The indexed turbine engine (see note) N1 value. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all far aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: TURB ENG N1 LOSS
units: This is used to control the N1 loss of the indexed engine
from 0 - no N1 loss - to 100 - 100% N1 loss.

simvars.name: TURB ENG N2
units: The indexed turbine engine (see note) N2 value. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all far aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: TURB ENG NUM TANKS USED
units: Number of tanks currently being used by the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: TURB ENG PRESSURE RATIO
units: The indexed engine (see note) pressure ratio.

simvars.name: TURB ENG PRIMARY NOZZLE PERCENT
units: Percent thrust of primary nozzle for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: TURB ENG REVERSE NOZZLE PERCENT
units: Percent thrust reverser nozzles deployed for the indexed engine (see note). NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all far aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: TURB ENG TANKS USED
units: Fuel tanks used by the indexed engine (see note)

one or more of the following bit flags: Center 1 Bit 0 Center 2 Bit 1 Center 3 Bit 2 Left Main Bit 3 Left Aux Bit 4 Left Tip Bit 5 Right Main Bit 6 Right Aux Bit 7 Right Tip Bit 8 External 1 Bit 9 External 2 Bit 10

simvars.name: TURB ENG TANK SELECTOR
units: Fuel tank selected for the indexed engine (see note). See Fuel Tank Selection for a list of values.

simvars.name: TURB ENG THROTTLE COMMANDED N1
units: The indexed turbine engine (see note) commanded N1 for current throttle position.

simvars.name: TURB ENG THRUST EFFICIENCY LOSS
units: This can be used to control the thrust efficiency loss of the indexed engine
where a value of 0 is 100% of available thrust
and 100 is 0% available thrust.

simvars.name: TURB ENG VIBRATION
units: The indexed turbine engine (see note) vibration value.

simvars.name: TURB MAX ITT
units: Retrieve the itt_peak_temperature as set in the engines.cfg file.

simvars.name: BETA DOT
units: Beta dot

simvars.name: DECISION ALTITUDE MSL
units: Design decision altitude above mean sea level

simvars.name: DECISION HEIGHT
units: Design decision height. This can be set for the aircraft in the FLT file using the DecisionHeight parameter. If not set it will default to 200.

simvars.name: DESIGN CRUISE ALT
units: This design constant represents the optimal altitude the aircraft should maintain when in cruise. It is derived from the cruise_alt setting in the section of the flightmodel.cfg. Default is 1500ft.

simvars.name: DESIGN SPAWN ALTITUDE CRUISE
units: This design constant represents the spawn altitude for the aircraft when spawning in cruise. It is derived from the spawn_cruise_altitude setting in the section of the flightmodel.cfg. Default is 1500ft.

simvars.name: DESIGN SPAWN ALTITUDE DESCENT
units: This design constant represents the spawn altitude for the aircraft when spawning in descent. It is derived from the spawn_descent_altitude setting in the section of the flightmodel.cfg. Default is 500ft.

simvars.name: DESIGN SPEED CLIMB
units: This design constant represents the optimal climb speed for the aircraft. It is derived from the climb_speed setting in the section of the flightmodel.cfg. Default value is -1.

simvars.name: DESIGN SPEED MIN ROTATION
units: This design constant represents the minimum speed required for aircraft rotation. It is derived from the rotation_speed_min setting in the section of the flightmodel.cfg. Default value is -1.

simvars.name: DESIGN SPEED VC
units: This design constant represents the aircraft ideal cruising speed. It is derived from the cruise_speed setting in the section of the flightmodel.cfg. The default value is computed an internal function that uses the estimated cruise altitude and estimated cruise percent power
according of the engine type
the number of engines
the density
the wing area and some drag parameters. Normally this value is set in the CFG file and the default value is never used.

simvars.name: DESIGN SPEED VS0
units: This design constant represents the the stall speed when flaps are fully extended. It is derived from the full_flaps_stall_speed setting in the section of the flightmodel.cfg. Default value is 0.8 x VS.

simvars.name: DESIGN SPEED VS1
units: This design constant represents the stall speed when flaps are fully retracted. It is derived from the flaps_up_stall_speed setting in the section of the flightmodel.cfg. Default value is 0.

simvars.name: DESIGN TAKEOFF SPEED
units: This design constant represents the aircraft ideal takoff speed. It is derived from the takeoff_speed setting in the section of the flightmodel.cfg.

simvars.name: DYNAMIC PRESSURE
units: Dynamic pressure

simvars.name: ESTIMATED CRUISE SPEED
units: Estimated cruise speed

simvars.name: G FORCE
units: Current G force

simvars.name: G LIMITER SETTING
units: This returns the setting of the G-limiter
as set using the GLimiterSetting parameter.

simvars.name: INCIDENCE ALPHA
units: The angle of attack based on the polling point selected using the group ID. For more information please see here: Note On Physics Groups

simvars.name: INCIDENCE BETA
units: Sideslip angle

simvars.name: IS TAIL DRAGGER
units: True if the aircraft is a taildragger

simvars.name: LINEAR CL ALPHA
units: Linear CL alpha

simvars.name: MACH MAX OPERATE
units: Maximum design mach

simvars.name: MAX G FORCE
units: Maximum G force attained

simvars.name: MIN DRAG VELOCITY
units: Minimum drag velocity
in clean
with no input and no gears
when at 10000ft.

simvars.name: MIN G FORCE
units: Minimum G force attained

simvars.name: REFERENCE SPEED MAX IAS
units: The maximum IAS that the aircraft can fly at.

simvars.name: REFERENCE SPEED MAX IAS GEAR DOWN
units: The maximum IAS that the aircraft can fly at with the landing gear extended.

simvars.name: SEMIBODY LOADFACTOR X
units: Deprecated
do not use!

simvars.name: SEMIBODY LOADFACTOR Y
units: Acceleration along the axis Y divided by the gravity constant G (usually around 9.81m.s²)

simvars.name: SEMIBODY LOADFACTOR YDOT
units: Derivative of SEMIBODY LOADFACTOR Y in relation to time.

simvars.name: SEMIBODY LOADFACTOR Z
units: Deprecated
do not use!

simvars.name: SIGMA SQRT
units: Sigma sqrt

simvars.name: SIMULATED RADIUS
units: Simulated radius

simvars.name: STALL ALPHA
units: The angle of attack which produces the maximum lift coefficient before entering into stall conditions.

simvars.name: STATIC PITCH
units: The angle at which static pitch stability is achieved.

simvars.name: TYPICAL DESCENT RATE
units: the typical (normal) descent rate for the aircraft.

simvars.name: WING AREA
units: Total wing area

simvars.name: WING FLEX PCT
units: The current wing flex. Different values can be set for each wing (for example
during banking). Set an index of 1 for the left wing
and 2 for the right wing.

simvars.name: WING SPAN
units: Total wing span

simvars.name: YAW STRING ANGLE
units: The yaw string angle. Yaw strings are attached to gliders as visible indicators of the yaw angle. Will only work when the yaw_string_available parameter is set to 1 (True).

simvars.name: YAW STRING PCT EXTENDED
units: Yaw string angle as a percentage. Will only work when the yaw_string_available parameter is set to 1 (True).

simvars.name: ZERO LIFT ALPHA
units: The angle of attack at which the wing has zero lift.

simvars.name: FUEL CROSS FEED
units: Cross feed valve setting. This will return the current setting for the fuel crossfeed for the indexed engine
based on the current status of the simulation and the Cross Feed key events.

simvars.name: FUEL DUMP ACTIVE
units: If 1 (TRUE) then the aircraft can dump fuel.

simvars.name: FUEL DUMP SWITCH
units: If set to 1 (TRUE) then the aircraft will dump fuel at the rate set by fuel_dump_rate parameter in the flight_model.cfg file.

simvars.name: FUEL LEFT CAPACITY
units: Maximum capacity in volume of all the tanks on the left side of the aircraft.

simvars.name: FUEL LEFT QUANTITY
units: Current quantity in volume of all the tanks on the left side of the aircraft.

simvars.name: FUEL PUMP
units: Currently not used within the simulation.

simvars.name: FUEL RIGHT CAPACITY
units: Maximum capacity in volume of all the tanks on the right side of the aircraft.

simvars.name: FUEL RIGHT QUANTITY
units: Current quantity in volume of all the tanks on the right side of the aircraft.

simvars.name: FUEL SELECTED QUANTITY
units: Quantity of fuel in the tank referenced by the indexed selector. When using the legacy fuel system

this SimVar will return the quantity of fuel in the tank pointed to by the selector you chose with the index. If passing an index higher than the number of selectors - or when using the modern fuel system - it will return the total fuel quantity available.

simvars.name: FUEL SELECTED QUANTITY PERCENT
units: Percent or capacity for the tank referenced by the indexed selector. When using the legacy fuel system

this SimVar will return the percentage of fuel in the tank pointed to by the selector you chose with the index. If passing an index higher than the number of selectors available - or when using the modern fuel system - it will return the percentage of total fuel quantity available.

simvars.name: FUEL SELECTED TRANSFER MODE
units: The method of transfer for the fuel. Each of the available transfer options are explained below: off - Fuel transfer is switched off. auto - Automatically balance the fuel between the Center1 and Center2 tanks to maintain the center of gravity. forward - Fuel will be transferred forwards from the Center1 tank to the Center2 tank. aft - Fuel will be transferred aftwards from the Center2 tank to the Center1 tank. manual - Fuel will be transferred for 1 second from the Center1 tank to the Center2 tank at a rate of 1lbs/s. custom - This requires one or more pumps to have been defined using the fuel_transfer_pump.N parameter in the flight_model.cfg file
as well as their associated electrical circuits.

simvars.name: FUEL TOTAL CAPACITY
units: Total fuel capacity of the aircraft for all tanks.

simvars.name: FUEL TOTAL QUANTITY
units: Current total quantity of fuel in volume for all tanks of the aircraft. The actual returned value will depend on the fuel system being used: Legacy fuel system [FUEL]: The value will include any unusable fuel. Modular fuel system [FUEL_SYSTEM]: The value will not include any unuseable fuel. This can be checked using the NEW FUEL SYSTEM SimVar.

simvars.name: FUEL TOTAL QUANTITY EX1
units: Current total quantity of fuel - including any unuseable fuel - for all tanks of the aircraft
regardless of the fuel system being used.

simvars.name: FUEL TOTAL QUANTITY WEIGHT
units: Current total fuel weight for all tanks of the aircraft. The actual returned value will depend on the fuel system being used: Legacy fuel system [FUEL]: The value will include any unusable fuel. Modular fuel system [FUEL_SYSTEM]: The value will not include any unuseable fuel. This can be checked using the NEW FUEL SYSTEM SimVar.

simvars.name: FUEL TOTAL QUANTITY WEIGHT EX1
units: Current total weight of fuel - including any unuseable fuel - for all tanks of the aircraft
regardless of the fuel system being used.

simvars.name: FUEL TRANSFER PUMP ON
units: Returns 1 (TRUE) if the indexed pump is active.

simvars.name: FUEL WEIGHT PER GALLON
units: The weight of the fuel
per gallon.

simvars.name: NEW FUEL SYSTEM
units: Will return 1 (TRUE) if the aircraft is using the modern [FUEL_SYSTEM] or 0 (FALSE) for the legacy [FUEL].

simvars.name: NUM FUEL SELECTORS
units: The number of fuel selectors on the aircraft.

simvars.name: UNLIMITED FUEL
units: Will return 1 (TRUE) if the unlimited fuel flag has been enabled
or 0 (FALSE) otherwise.

simvars.name: UNUSABLE FUEL TOTAL QUANTITY
units: The total amount of fuel in all tanks of the aircraft which is not usable.

simvars.name: CONTRAILS CONDITIONS MET
units: True if the aircraft has met the conditions required to spawn the contrail VFX.

simvars.name: COVER ON
units: Whether the indexed aircraft part has the covers on (1
True) or off (0
false). The index can be one of the following to define the part being checked: 0 - Chocks 1 - Engines 2 - Pitot 3 - StaticPorts 4 - Rotors 5 - LandingGear 6 - Propellers

simvars.name: IS SLEW ACTIVE
units: True if slew is active.

simvars.name: IS SLEW ALLOWED
units: True if slew is enabled.

simvars.name: IS USER SIM
units: Is this the user loaded aircraft.

simvars.name: ON ANY RUNWAY
units: Whether or not the plane is currently on a runway.

simvars.name: PLANE IN PARKING STATE
units: Whether or not the plane is currently parked (true) or not (false).

simvars.name: SURFACE CONDITION
units: The state of the surface directly under the aircraft. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position
regardless of where the camera is
or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: SURFACE INFO VALID
units: True indicates that the SURFACE CONDITION return value is meaningful.

simvars.name: SURFACE TYPE
units: The type of surface under the aircraft. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position
regardless of where the camera is
or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: STRUCTURAL ICE PCT
units: Amount of ice on aircraft structure. 100 is fully iced.

simvars.name: TITLE
units: Title from aircraft.cfg.

simvars.name: LIVERY NAME
units: Name from livery.cfg.

simvars.name: LIVERY FOLDER
units: Folder where livery.cfg is stored.

simvars.name: WINDSHIELD RAIN EFFECT AVAILABLE
units: Is visual effect available on this aircraft.

simvars.name: ADF ACTIVE FREQUENCY
units: ADF frequency. Index of 1 or 2.

simvars.name: ADF AVAILABLE
units: True if indexed ADF is available

simvars.name: ADF CARD
units: ADF compass rose setting

simvars.name: ADF DISTANCE
units: The ADF signal distance.

units: Deprecated

simvars.name: ADF SIGNAL
units: Signal strength

simvars.name: ADF SOUND
units: ADF audio flag. Index of 0 or 1.

units: True if ADF Standby is available

units: ADF standby frequency

simvars.name: CABIN NO SMOKING ALERT SWITCH
units: True if the No Smoking switch is on.

simvars.name: CABIN SEATBELTS ALERT SWITCH
units: True if the Seatbelts switch is on.

simvars.name: CANOPY OPEN
units: Percent primary door/exit open.

simvars.name: CARB HEAT AVAILABLE
units: True if carburetor heat available.

units: Generic SimVar.

simvars.name: FIRE BOTTLE SWITCH
units: True if the fire bottle switch is on.

simvars.name: GLASSCOCKPIT AUTOMATIC BRIGHTNESS
units: This variable will return a value between 0 and 1 for the automatic brightness setting for glass cockpit displays
where 0 is the dimmest and 1 is the brightest. This value will vary depending on the time of day.

simvars.name: GPWS SYSTEM ACTIVE
units: True if the Ground Proximity Warning System is active.

simvars.name: GPWS WARNING
units: True if Ground Proximity Warning System installed.

units: Angular error of heading indicator.

simvars.name: HAS STALL PROTECTION
units: Will return whether the aircraft has stall protection (true) or not (false).

simvars.name: HEADING INDICATOR
units: Heading indicator (directional gyro) indication.

simvars.name: INDICATED ALTITUDE
units: The indicated altitude.

simvars.name: INDICATED ALTITUDE CALIBRATED
units: Indicated altitude with the altimeter calibrated to current sea level pressure.

simvars.name: INDICATED ALTITUDE EX1
units: Similar to INDICATED_ALTITUDE but doesn't affect actual plane position when setting this variable.

simvars.name: INDUCTOR COMPASS HEADING REF
units: Inductor compass heading.

simvars.name: INDUCTOR COMPASS PERCENT DEVIATION
units: Inductor compass deviation reading.

simvars.name: INSTRUMENTS AVAILABLE
units: Deprecated
do not use!

simvars.name: INTERCOM MODE
units: Intercom Mode

simvars.name: INTERCOM SYSTEM ACTIVE
units: Whether or not the intercom system is active.

simvars.name: IS ALTITUDE FREEZE ON
units: True if the altitude of the aircraft is frozen.

simvars.name: IS ATTITUDE FREEZE ON
units: True if the attitude (pitch
bank and heading) of the aircraft is frozen.

simvars.name: IS LATITUDE LONGITUDE FREEZE ON
units: True if the lat/lon of the aircraft (either user or AI controlled) is frozen. If this variable returns true
it means that the latitude and longitude of the aircraft are not being controlled by the simulation
so enabling
for example
a SimConnect client to control the position of the aircraft. This can also apply to altitude and attitude. Also refer to the range of FREEZE_* Event IDs.

simvars.name: KOHLSMAN SETTING HG
units: The value for the given altimeter index in inches of mercury. IMPORTANT! In the system.cfg file
altimeters are indexed from 0
but the SimVar indexes from 1. So
altimeter 0 in that file is accessed using KOHLSMAN SETTING HG:1
1 by KOHLSMAN SETTING HG:2
etc...

simvars.name: KOHLSMAN SETTING MB
units: The value for the given altimeter index in millibars. IMPORTANT! In the system.cfg file
altimeters are indexed from 0
but the SimVar indexes from 1. So
altimeter 0 in that file is accessed using KOHLSMAN SETTING MB:1
1 by KOHLSMAN SETTING MB:2
etc...

simvars.name: KOHLSMAN SETTING STD
units: True if the indexed altimeter is in "Standard" mode
or false otherwise. IMPORTANT! In the system.cfg file
altimeters are indexed from 0
but the SimVar indexes from 1. So
altimeter 0 in that file is accessed using KOHLSMAN SETTING STD:1
1 by KOHLSMAN SETTING STD:2
etc...

simvars.name: MAGNETIC COMPASS
units: Compass reading.

simvars.name: MANUAL FUEL PUMP HANDLE
units: Position of manual fuel pump handle. 1 is fully deployed.

simvars.name: OVERSPEED WARNING
units: Overspeed warning state.

simvars.name: PANEL ANTI ICE SWITCH
units: True if panel anti-ice switch is on.

simvars.name: PITOT ICE PCT
units: Amount of pitot ice. 100 is fully iced.

simvars.name: PITOT HEAT
units: Pitot heat active.

simvars.name: PITOT HEAT SWITCH
units: Pitot heat switch state.

simvars.name: PLANE HEADING DEGREES GYRO
units: Heading indicator (directional gyro) indication.

simvars.name: RAD INS SWITCH
units: True if Rad INS switch on.

simvars.name: SELECTED DME
units: Selected DME.

simvars.name: SMOKESYSTEM AVAILABLE
units: Smoke system available. NOTE: There is no default "smoke system" that this SimVar works on and this is a legacy variable that is available for use should you wish to use it but it affects nothing by default.

simvars.name: SMOKE ENABLE
units: Set to True to activate the smoke system
if one is available. Please see the notes for SMOKESYSTEM AVAILABLE for more information.

simvars.name: SPEAKER ACTIVE
units: Whether or not the speaker is active.

simvars.name: STALL HORN AVAILABLE
units: True if stall alarm available.

simvars.name: STALL PROTECTION OFF LIMIT
units: Alpha below which the Stall Protection can be disabled. See the [STALL PROTECTION] section for more information.

simvars.name: STALL PROTECTION ON GOAL
units: The alpha that the Stall Protection will attempt to reach when triggered. See the [STALL PROTECTION] section for more information.

simvars.name: STALL PROTECTION ON LIMIT
units: Alpha above which the Stall Protection timer starts. See the [STALL PROTECTION] section for more information.

simvars.name: STALL PROTECTION SYSTEM YOKE SHAKER INTENSITY
units: Used to detect the current stall protection system shaker state.

simvars.name: STALL WARNING
units: Stall warning state.

simvars.name: STRUCTURAL DEICE SWITCH
units: True if the aircraft structure deice switch is on.

simvars.name: SUCTION PRESSURE
units: Vacuum system suction pressure.

simvars.name: TRUE AIRSPEED SELECTED
units: True if True Airspeed has been selected.

simvars.name: TURN COORDINATOR BALL
units: Turn coordinator ball position.

simvars.name: TURN COORDINATOR BALL INV
units: Turn coordinator ball position inverted (upside down).

simvars.name: TURN INDICATOR RATE
units: Turn indicator reading. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all near aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

units: True if the aircraft windshield deice switch is on.
